collar_tag_req: In Port Colborne, all dogs are required to be licensed and wear a tag. Dog licenses are only valid for the calendar year in which it was purchased.
dog_limit: You are not allowed to have more than three (3) dogs, excluding unweaned puppies, on any property in the City of Port Colborne.

collar_tag_req: Dogs must be licensed and tagged annually.

lgd_definition: "Working Dog" shall include sheep dogs and mean a dog trained to aid in herding or protecting sheep and is actually being used for that purpose.
collar_tag_req: Upon registration, each owner shall be furnished with a licence tag, which shall be secured by the owner to the cat or dog at all times.
dog_limit: No person shall keep, or do anything which may cause to be kept, more than three (3) animals of any particular species nor an aggregate of four (4) animals, in or about any one dwelling unit.
notes: Includes 'Working Dog' definition which encompasses guarding/herding, and provides an exemption for Working Dogs from nuisance and running at large sections while engaged in work. URL: https://www.smithsfalls.ca/media/1j5kfmad/animal-control-by-law-8856-2016.pdf

lgd_definition: "Livestock Guardian Dog" means a dog that works and/or lives with domestic farm animals (e.g. cattle, sheep, poultry) to protect them by repelling predators and is used exclusively for that purpose.
herding_definition: "Herding Dog" means a dog that has been trained and is actively being used in a bona fide farming operation for the purposes of controlling livestock on the farm.
collar_tag_req: Every dog owner shall, on or before the 28th day of February in each and every year, register such dog or dogs with the Clerk or his/her designate or with the Animal Control Officer and pay the prescribed fees.
dog_limit: Maximum of two (2) dogs within Urban Boundaries and a maximum of three (3) dogs harbored at any one time on a property in Rural areas.

collar_tag_req: Every person who owns a dog shall ensure it has valid identification, such as an identification tag or other similar means of identification affixed to it at all times.

An identification tag shall be issued for every licensed dog that shows the dog licence number. Every dog owner shall ensure that the identification tag issued by the Township is kept securely affixed to its dog all times.
dog_limit: No person shall keep more than three (3) dogs over twenty (20) weeks of age per premise.

collar_tag_req: The Town of Spanish requires all dogs and cats to be licensed. All renewals are due annually by February 15th.
notes: BYLAW NOT FOUND. Licensing information available on website but full by-law text could not be located. URL: https://www.townofspanish.com/municipal-departments/animal-control/

collar_tag_req: All dogs require a dog tag/licence in accordance with By-Law 295-02. Failure to secure tag to collar results in a fine.
notes: Full by-law text not publicly hosted, but animal control web summary confirms basic licensing rules. URL: https://www.stirling-rawdon.com/living-here/animal-control/dog-tags/

lgd_definition: "Livestock Guardian Dog" shall mean Great Pyrenees, Akbash, Kuvasz, Maremma and Anatolian Shepherd and crosses between these breeds that exclusively work and/or live with domestic farm animals to protect them by repelling predators. It being understood that a Livestock Guardian Dog must work/live on a property that is zoned appropriately for agricultural use or a hobby farm and is engaged in a normal farm practice to benefit from the specific exemptions outlined in this By-law.
herding_definition: "Herding Dog" must work/live on a property that is zoned appropriately for agricultural use or a hobby farm and is engaged in a normal farm practice to benefit from the specific exemptions outlined in this By-law.
collar_tag_req: On payment of the license fee for each dog, the owner shall be furnished with a dog tag which shall be kept securely fixed on the dog at all times until the tag is renewed or replaced.
notes: Amended by By-law 2022-94 to explicitly define and grant specific exemptions to Livestock Guardian Dogs and Herding Dogs from certain nuisance restrictions. URL: https://www.southfrontenac.net/media/1ctnsvgu/by-law-2001-66-dog-control.pdf

collar_tag_req: As a dog owner in Township of Stone Mills, you must license your dog(s) each year... and receive a dog tag.
